Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http_ dllg.gov,ph OPINION NO. 25 s. 20L VICE MAYOR MA. JOSEFINA G. BELMONTE Office of the Vice Mayor 2/F Legislative Wing Bldg. Quezon City Hall Diliman, Quezon City Dear Vice Mayor Belmonte: 22 MAY This has reference to your letter dated 12 April 2018 requesting for the Department's Legal Opinion on "whether the signature of the Congressman himself/herself is mandatory for the budget process to proceed". This query was premised on the provision under Item No. 3, Section 107 of R.A. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", which included a representative of the Congressman as member of the Barangay Development Council. We opine in the negative. The signature of the congressman concerned is not required in order for the budget process to proceed. What is needed in the budgeting process is the approved Barangay Development Plan. As explained by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM)I, "(t)he need to prepare a Barangay Development Plan (BDP) is in accordance with the budgeting principle that "local government budgets shall operationalize the approved local development plans" as mandated under Sec. 305 of R.A. No. 7160. Without the priority programs and projects embodied in theplan, there is no basis for theprogramming of funds and therefore no basis for budgeting While we are on this, we should take due notice of the composition of the Barangay Development Council under Section 107 of R.A. No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991". To wit: "Section 107. Composition Of Local Development Councils. composition of the local development council shall be as follows: (I) Members of the sangguniang barangay; (2) Representatives of non-governmental organizations operating in the barangay who shall constitute not less joo The

than one fourth (1%) of the members of the fully organized council; (3) A representative of the congressman. " It is specifically mentioned under Item No. 3 of the aforecited provision that the third member of the Council is a representative of the Congressman, not the Congressman himself. Nonetheless, pursuant to Section 109(b)(2) of the Local Government Code, the function of the Barangay Development Council is merely the preparation of the Barangay Development Plan perse. Hence, the approval thereof lies with the Sangguniang Barangay concerned. Further, we respectfully note Section 319 of the Local Government Code which reads as follows: "Section 319. Legislative Authorization of the Budget. - On or before the end of the current fiscal year, the sanggunian concerned shall, through an ordinance, the annual budget of the local government unit for the ensuing fiscal year on the basis ofthe estimates ofincome and expenditures submitted by the local chief executive. " Premises considered, a logical deduction will follow that as long as the Barangay budget plan is in accordance with the Barangay Development Plan approved by the Sangguniang Barangay, the budget process shall proceed subject to all other requirements prescribed by law and existing policies. For all your budget preparation concerns, we refer you to Local Budget Memorandum No. 75 s. 2017 entitled "FY 2018 INTERNAL REVENUE ALLOTMENT AND GUIDELINES ON THE PREPARATION OF THE FY 2018 ANNUAL BUDGETS OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS". cc: We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. DIR. MARIA LOURDES L AGUSTIN, CESO lv Regional Director DILG - National Capital Region (NCR) Very truly yours, of the Secretary: By auth AUSTERE A.
